title: Incremental Consistency Execution for Autonomous Intelligent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.24090v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon autonomous intelligent systems rely on heterogeneous components such as large language models, databases, external APIs, and rule engines, while their external states continuously change during execution. Re-executing the entire workflow after every change introduces substantial redundant computation. This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and state perturbation result invariant domains. After an initial verified execution, the system constructs conservative invariant domains for critical inputs and uses them to determine whether downstream results can be safely renewed without re-invoking expensive components. When re-execution is required, only the smallest affected output fields are recomputed, and an equivalence barrier prevents unnecessary downstream propagation. translated_title: 面向自主智能系统的增量一致性执行
translated_abstract: 长时程自主智能系统依赖大型语言模型、数据库、外部API和规则引擎等异构组件，同时其外部状态在执行过程中持续变化。每次变化后重新执行整个工作流会引入大量冗余计算。本文提出了一种基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码和状态扰动结果不变域的增量一致性执行方法。在经过验证的初始执行之后，系统为关键输入构建保守的不变域，并利用它们判断是否可以在不重新调用昂贵组件的情况下安全地更新下游结果。当需要重新执行时，仅重新计算受影响最小的输出字段，并通过等价屏障防止不必要的下游传播。提交时的版本一致性门进一步确保了安全性（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码和不变域的增量一致性执行方法，使自主智能系统在外部状态变化时只需重算最小受影响的输出字段，从而大幅减少冗余计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and invariant domains, enabling autonomous intelligent systems to recompute only the minimally affected output fields upon external state changes, thereby substantially reducing redundant computation.
